entry.title: Slotiva 1.0.3
entry.summary: Running the setup wizard again keeps your product's own settings, clearer limits, and help links to this site.
entry.content:
Slotiva 1.0.3 is a maintenance release. If you have already set up a bookable product, the most important change is that running the setup wizard again no longer touches that product's own settings.

Fixed​

  • Running the setup wizard again keeps your product's settings. An existing bookable product keeps its own appointment length, minimum hours per order and pricing. Step 3 tells you when the product keeps its own length, and the customer preview and the summary show that length. See Setup wizard.
  • The summary always shows your service type, also when you kept the suggested type without clicking a card.
  • One limit for the appointment length: 480 minutes (8 hours). It applies everywhere you can set a length — the setup wizard, Slotiva → Working hours and the product's Slotiva tab. If a longer length was saved earlier, it does not stop you from saving your other working-hours settings. The wizard also refuses a price that is not a valid number.
  • Activating Slotiva in a way that cannot open the setup wizard (for example from the command line or network-wide) no longer leaves an older "open the wizard" note behind that would send you to the wizard later.

Changed​

  • License screen: the same views and texts as before, now with a help link under every state once a key is entered. The update hint names the current WordPress menu: Plugins → Add Plugin → Upload Plugin.
  • Slotiva → Settings → Bookable products now says Per slot instead of "Per hour", the same as the product's Slotiva tab.
  • The payment check in the setup wizard now says where to turn a payment method on: WooCommerce → Settings → Payments.
  • Turkish admin texts now use the same informal voice everywhere.

Added​

  • Help links to this documentation: First-time setup guide at the end of the setup wizard, How to fix on every checkout-check row that needs attention, and About this license status on the License screen. Admins who use WordPress in Turkish get the Turkish pages.

Updating​

Download 1.0.3 from your account and install it via Plugins → Add Plugin → Upload Plugin — see Updating. Your appointments, working hours and settings are kept.
